```{r}
# Skip the first row and treat the second row as the header
```

```{r}
# Assuming 'subjectkey' is one of the columns in shaps_df
subjectkeys <- shaps_df$subjectkey

# Create a new data frame excluding the specified columns
columns_to_exclude <- c('src_subject_id', 'sex', 'interview_date', 'interview_age', 'shaps_total',
```

```{r}
shaps_data_clean <- shaps_data[na_proportion <= 0.6, ]
```

```{r}
# Create a method vector for your 14 binary columns (all using logistic regression)
method_vector <- rep("logreg", ncol(shaps_data_clean))
names(method_vector) <- names(shaps_data_clean)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Run the imputation on the data without subjectkey
imputed_data <- mice(shaps_data_clean, method = method_vector, m = 5)
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate percentages
calculate_percentages <- function(data) {
  result <- data.frame(Variable = character(), 
                       Percent_0_Original = numeric(), 
                       Percent_1_Original = numeric(), 
                       Percent_0_Imputed = numeric(), 
                       Percent_1_Imputed = numeric(), 
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  for (col in names(data)) {
    counts <- table(data[[col]], useNA = "ifany")
    total <- sum(counts)
    percent_0 <- round(100 * (counts["0"] %||% 0) / total, 2)
    percent_1 <- round(100 * (counts["1"] %||% 0) / total, 2)
    
    result <- rbind(result, data.frame(Variable = col, 
                                       Percent_0_Original = percent_0, 
                                       Percent_1_Original = percent_1,
                                       Percent_0_Imputed = NA, 
                                       Percent_1_Imputed = NA))
  }
  return(result)
}

# Helper to handle missing counts
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.na(a)) a else b

# Calculate percentages for original data
original_percentages <- calculate_percentages(shaps_data_clean)

# Get the first imputed dataset
imputed_data_first <- complete(imputed_data, action = 1)

# Calculate percentages for imputed data
imputed_percentages <- calculate_percentages(imputed_data_first)

# Merge the results
final_result <- original_percentages
final_result$Percent_0_Imputed <- imputed_percentages$Percent_0_Original
final_result$Percent_1_Imputed <- imputed_percentages$Percent_1_Original

# Display the final table
print(final_result)
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate percentages
calculate_percentages <- function(data) {
  result <- data.frame(Variable = character(), 
                       Percent_0 = numeric(), 
                       Percent_1 = numeric(), 
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  for (col in names(data)) {
    if (col != "subjectkey") {  # Ignore subjectkey column
      counts <- table(data[[col]], useNA = "ifany")
      total <- sum(counts)
      percent_0 <- round(100 * (counts["0"] %||% 0) / total, 2)
      percent_1 <- round(100 * (counts["1"] %||% 0) / total, 2)

      result <- rbind(result, data.frame(Variable = col, 
                                         Percent_0 = percent_0, 
                                         Percent_1 = percent_1))
    }
  }
  return(result)
}

# Helper to handle missing counts
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.na(a)) a else b

# Calculate percentages for original data
original_percentages <- calculate_percentages(shaps_data_clean)

# Initialize list to store differences and imputed datasets
imputed_results <- list()
differences <- numeric()

# Loop through all 5 imputed datasets
for (i in 1:5) {
  imputed_data_i <- complete(imputed_data, action = i)
  imputed_percentages <- calculate_percentages(imputed_data_i)

  # Calculate absolute difference between original and imputed percentages
  diff_0 <- abs(original_percentages$Percent_0 - imputed_percentages$Percent_0)
  diff_1 <- abs(original_percentages$Percent_1 - imputed_percentages$Percent_1)
  total_diff <- sum(diff_0 + diff_1)

  # Store results
  imputed_results[[i]] <- imputed_percentages
  differences[i] <- total_diff
}

# Identify the imputed dataset with the smallest difference
best_imputation_index <- which.min(differences)
best_imputed_percentages <- imputed_results[[best_imputation_index]]

# Prepare the final table
final_result <- data.frame(
  Variable = original_percentages$Variable,
  Percent_0_Original = original_percentages$Percent_0,
  Percent_1_Original = original_percentages$Percent_1,
  Percent_0_Imputed = best_imputed_percentages$Percent_0,
  Percent_1_Imputed = best_imputed_percentages$Percent_1
)

# Display the final table for the best performing imputed dataset
cat(paste0("Best Performing Imputed Dataset: Imputation #", best_imputation_index, "\n"))
print(final_result)

```
